title: Role and Contribution of Serological Surveillance in Animals and Exposed Humans to the Study of Zoonotic Influenza Disease Epidemiology: A Scoping Review.

diseases.name_zh: 人感染高致病性禽流感

zh.research_question: 该综述旨在梳理2017年至2024年间全球关于动物及暴露人群血清学监测的研究现状，并评估其在人畜共患流感流行病学研究中的作用与方法进展。
zh.study_design: 研究采用范围综述设计，遵循PRISMA-ScR指南检索PubMed数据库，纳入2017年1月至2024年3月发表的相关英文同行评审文献。
zh.population_setting: 纳入数据涵盖33个国家的25种动物物种，其中家禽与生猪的血清学调查最为集中，同时涉及部分伴侣动物、野生哺乳动物及职业暴露人类群体。
zh.main_findings: 最终筛选出90项符合条件的研究，结果显示跨物种传播界面及非经济动物的监测资料相对匮乏。新兴的多重检测与纳米抗体技术虽具应用潜力，但在实际部署中仍面临操作与推广障碍。
zh.public_health_relevance: 将血清学监测更深度地整合至“同一健康”策略中，有望强化高风险区域与人兽交界地的早期预警能力与大流行防范准备。
zh.limitations: 本综述仅依赖单一电子数据库且限定英文文献，未开展正式的质量评价，且纳入的各项研究之间存在显著的异质性。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该文献系统归纳了现有血清学监测研究的地理与物种分布特征，揭示了当前数据覆盖的盲区，可为后续监测网络优化提供背景参考，但不代表实时疫情追踪结果。

en.research_question: The authors sought to catalog worldwide research on antibody tracking for zoonotic influenza across animal reservoirs and at-risk human cohorts over a seven-year period.
en.study_design: A systematic scoping review was conducted using PRISMA-ScR protocols to evaluate peer-reviewed literature indexed in PubMed.
en.population_setting: Eligible records covered thirty-three nations and documented twenty-five distinct animal taxa, with particular emphasis on agricultural livestock and workers with direct animal contact.
en.main_findings: Analysis of ninety qualifying papers demonstrated that current antibody monitoring predominantly targets poultry and pigs, leaving wildlife and companion species significantly understudied. While advanced testing formats such as multiplex and nanobody assays emerged, practical adoption continues to encounter operational hurdles.
en.public_health_relevance: Expanding antibody-based monitoring programs across interconnected health sectors may improve early identification of cross-species viral circulation and strengthen global outbreak readiness.
en.limitations: The authors note that restricting searches to one repository, excluding non-English works, omitting formal study quality evaluation, and encountering high methodological diversity constrain the review's comprehensiveness.
en.gids_interpretation: This work functions as a bibliometric and methodological inventory of historical antibody tracking initiatives for avian and swine influenza, offering context on regional coverage and technical evolution without referencing active outbreak monitoring.

why_it_matters_en: Expanding antibody-based monitoring programs across interconnected health sectors may improve early identification of cross-species viral circulation and strengthen global outbreak readiness.
